# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, and is a breaking upgrade from v3. This release rolls up everything from the 4.147.x preview series: variable fonts, animated WebP, color font palettes, zero-copy stream and pixel APIs, WASM improvements, and security-refreshed native libraries. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from 3.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **`new SKFont()` now uses an empty typeface instead of lazy default resolution** — Upstream Skia m132 removed the lazy 'resolve default at draw time' pattern. `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` (0 glyphs), so `MeasureText("Hello")` returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Detect unset via `font.Typeface.IsEmpty`; construct with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)` for text that draws. ([#3735](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3735))
- **`new SKPaint().Typeface` returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of `null`** — Code that used `paint.Typeface == null` to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Text still draws by default. Use `paint.Typeface.IsEmpty` for the check, or drop it — a usable default is always present. ([#3736](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3736))
- **`SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns `Default` instead of `null` on Android for missing families** — All platforms now return `SKTypeface.Default` for unknown family names. Code that branched on a `null` return on Android must switch to `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns `null` on no match. ([#3737](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3737))
- **`SKStream.Move(long)` is now obsolete and throws on out-of-range offsets** — The native offset is 32-bit; the `long` overload now uses a checked cast and throws `OverflowException` for values outside `int` range, rather than silently truncating. Switch to `Move(int)`, validating/clamping large values first. ([#3740](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3740))
- **`GRContext.CreateVulkan` terminates the process on Vulkan 1.0 — no longer returns `null`** — Skia m139+ requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance now calls `SK_ABORT` and kills the process — it cannot be caught. Set `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` to `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` and also set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to the same value; the default `0` is no longer safe. ([#4600](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4600))
- **`GRVkBackendContextNative` — five interop fields removed** — Upstream removed `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments; use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **`GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo` lost value-equality; `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` changed type** — The type was renamed to `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` and a new `Components` field was added. Value-equality (`IEquatable`, `==`, `!=`) was removed. Update equality comparisons and add the new field where you construct the struct. ([#3741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3741))
- **`SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose` setter is removed** — The `protected set` on `IgnorePublicDispose` is gone; the property is now read-only after construction. Update any subclass that assigned to it directly.
- **Pre-v4 obsolete members promoted to compile errors** — APIs marked `[Obsolete(error:true)]` during the 3.x-to-4.x transition — legacy paint text/font state (`SKPaint.Typeface`, `SKPaint.TextSize`, etc.) and the removed enum members — are now compile errors. Migrate to the `SKFont` equivalents. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m148** — The bundled Skia engine advances through m132, m147, and m148, picking up upstream rendering improvements, text-shaping enhancements, and stability fixes across the whole pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## API Surface

- **Variable font support** — SkiaSharp now exposes Skia's variable font axis API, letting consumers read and set variation axes on a typeface at runtime. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — A new `SKWebpEncoder` API encodes multi-frame animated WebP images from a sequence of bitmaps. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Color font palette support** — New APIs expose the named color palettes embedded in color fonts (COLR/CPAL), allowing consumers to select or override the active palette at draw time. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Zero-copy stream and pixel APIs** — `SKStream.GetData()` extracts a stream's contents as an `SKData` without copying when the stream is already memory-backed. `SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan` now correctly uses `RowBytes` for stride and the right axis for element offsets. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **Drawing API additions** — `SKSamplingOptions` support was added to `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface`, and the `HBColor` value type was introduced in HarfBuzzSharp for proper `hb_color_t` representation. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **Missing wrappers and naming fixes** — A number of missing C API wrappers were added and naming convention violations were corrected in the public API surface. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — A crash when `SKPathBuilder` was garbage-collected before `SKPath` is resolved: the finalizer order is now safe. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Default typeface resolution fixed on Android API 36+** — `SKTypeface.Default` now falls back to `SKTypeface.Empty` instead of crashing when the system font manager returns null on Android API 36. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3738](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3738))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found fixed** — Resolves a `DllNotFoundException` for the WinUI projection DLL when consuming SkiaSharp from .NET 9 WinUI apps. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView blank after tab switch fixed** — Fixed an issue where `SKGLView` stopped rendering after switching tabs in a MAUI `TabBar` on Android. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton instance lifecycle reworked** — The handle-registry singleton pattern was overhauled to fix subtle double-dispose and resurrection races when managed wrappers are finalized concurrently. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi constructor** — The native compatibility check moved from `[ModuleInitializer]` to the `SkiaApi` static constructor, giving better diagnostics and avoiding initialization-order issues. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic (Android NDK sysroot) native assets added** — Pre-built native libraries for Linux Bionic targets (used in some embedded and cross-compiled Android NDK scenarios) are now included in the NuGet packages. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217))
- **Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds added** — The Tizen platform now ships x64 and arm64 native assets in addition to the existing armel build. ([#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple platform TFMs corrected** — Library TFMs now use the versioned `26.0` moniker; app TFMs use the unversioned form. This aligns with Apple's recommended packaging and eliminates TFM resolution warnings. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WASM: dropped pre-.NET 8 Emscripten targets** — Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes have been removed. .NET 8+ Emscripten builds remain. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Native dependency security updates** — Bundled native libraries were updated: libpng to 1.6.58, libexpat to 2.7.5, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, freetype to 2.14.3, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, expat to 2.8.1, and HarfBuzz to 14.2.0. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 adds the `HBColor` value type for proper `hb_color_t` representation, gains variable font shaping support through the new SkiaSharp variable font APIs, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz library to 14.2.0.

The release candidate finalized the Skia m148 upgrade, pixel-access stride and offset fixes, the singleton lifecycle rework, legacy paint-member errors, and the `SKNativeObject` setter removal.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)

Preview 3 added the HBColor value type, missing API wrappers, TreatWarningsAsErrors cleanup, libjpeg-turbo and HarfBuzz updates, and CI improvements.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.2.1...v4.147.0-preview.3.1)

Preview 2 introduced animated WebP encoding, the SKPath finalizer fix, corrected Apple platform TFMs, and zero-copy `SKStream.GetData()`.

Preview 1 opened the v4 line on Skia m132/m147: variable fonts, color font palettes, `SKSamplingOptions` on surface/canvas draw, Linux Bionic, Tizen native builds, and security-refreshed native libraries.
